documents.title: FY2026 Q3 Capital Expenditure & Cloud Margin Review
documents.raw_content: Q3 cloud infrastructure expenditures grew 14.2% quarter-over-quarter to $1.42M, primarily driven by GPU cluster provisioning for enterprise AI models. Operational margins contracted slightly to 71.4%. Recommendation: Implement reserved instance scheduling and cold-storage offloading by November 15, 2026 to reclaim approximately $180,000 monthly.
documents.ai_summary: Cloud expenditure climbed 14.2% to $1.42M due to GPU provisioning. Recommends RI reservations and storage tiering before mid-November to save $180K/mo.

actionItems: Audit idle GPU instances across staging clusters
Present revised unit economics at next Board Operations committee

documents.title: Global Remote Work & Cross-Border Compliance Policy 2026
documents.raw_content: This policy governs cross-border employment arrangements across APAC and EMEA. Mandatory 180-day physical presence thresholds trigger domestic corporate tax nexus obligations. All international business travel over 14 consecutive calendar days requires prior written sign-off from People Operations and Finance.
documents.ai_summary: Establishes international compliance boundaries for overseas remote employees, codifying 180-day tax nexus triggers and mandatory 14-day travel pre-approvals.

actionItems: Integrate automated immigration duration tracking into HRIS
Distribute updated tax residency compliance guidelines to department leads

documents.title: Enterprise Architecture Spec: Distributed RAG & Semantic Cache
documents.raw_content: Design specification for zero-leakage enterprise retrieval augmented generation. Embeddings generated via Gemini multimodal pipeline. Vector similarity query latency SLA set at under 35ms p99. Strict tenant isolation enforced at row-level security and vector collection partitions.
documents.ai_summary: Technical architecture specification outlining p99 <35ms query latency SLA and strict multi-tenant isolation for Gemini embedding pipelines.

actionItems: Bench-test vector indexing throughput under 10k concurrent RPS
Verify zero cross-tenant query leakage in security penetration testing
Deploy hot cache failover across secondary availability zone
